name: 01_issuer_mismatch
title: Issuer of Patient ID differs
description: Same Patient ID (00012345) in both files, but IssuerOfPatientID is SYNTH-HOSP-A in A and SYNTH-HOSP-B in B.
symptom: Cross-facility identity collision: an MPI or PACS that ignores the issuer merges two different patients who share an MRN, or rejects the study as a mismatch.
